tournament.name: April OCC Clash Qualifier B
tournament.description: OCC CLASH APRIL SCHEDULE: Qualifier Brackets - April 15 @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline April 15 @ 1200 GMT) - (participation confirmation deadline April 14) - The qualifier brackets are seeded based on the position of the player on the OC leader-board at the end of the season. Round of 8 Finals - April 22 @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline April 20 @ 2300 GMT) -The Round of 8 Finals are seeded based on OC leaderboard at the end of the season in addition to the final 2 qualified players being positioned in #7 and #8.
